workspaces.description: Official Sahayak AI customer support and automated knowledge base.

faqs.question: What subscription pricing plans do you offer?
faqs.answer: We offer three subscription tiers: Free ($0/mo for up to 500 conversations), Starter ($29/mo for up to 5,000 conversations with custom branding), and Business ($99/mo for up to 25,000 conversations with priority support and team access).

faqs.question: What is your refund and cancellation policy?
faqs.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time directly from the Settings page. We offer a full 14-day money-back guarantee on all paid plans if you are not satisfied with the service. Refunds are processed back to the original payment method within 5 to 7 business days.

faqs.question: What are the API rate limits for requests?
faqs.answer: Standard API plans include a rate limit of 60 requests per minute and 5,000 requests per day. Business tier accounts can request custom rate limits up to 300 requests per minute by contacting our engineering support team.

faqs.question: How do I reset my account password if I forgot it?
faqs.answer: Click the "Forgot Password" link on the login screen, enter your registered email address, and we will send you a secure password reset link valid for 60 minutes.

faqs.question: Is two-factor authentication (2FA) supported?
faqs.answer: Yes, two-factor authentication (2FA) using TOTP apps such as Google Authenticator, Authy, or 1Password is supported and recommended for all workspace members under Account Settings > Security.

faqs.question: How do I embed the chatbot widget onto my website?
faqs.answer: Go to your Dashboard > Chatbot Embed page, copy the generated <script> code snippet, and paste it right before the closing </body> tag of your website HTML or theme file. It works on plain HTML, WordPress, Shopify, Next.js, and Webflow.

faqs.question: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), Net Banking, and UPI (via Razorpay in supported regions). Invoicing with bank transfers is available for annual Business plans.

faqs.question: Where is customer data hosted and is it encrypted?
faqs.answer: All data is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.3 and encrypted at rest using AES-256. Our primary databases are hosted in ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II certified data centers with strict tenant isolation.

faqs.question: What happens if my workspace exceeds the monthly conversation limit?
faqs.answer: If you reach your plan limit, your widget continues running, but subsequent incoming queries will display a friendly rate limit notification unless you upgrade your tier or enable burst allowance in billing settings.

faqs.question: How do I contact customer support if my issue is not answered?
faqs.answer: You can email our support team directly at support@technova.example.com or submit a ticket through the dashboard. Priority support response time is within 2 hours during business hours (9 AM - 6 PM EST).

faqs.question: What is Sahayak AI and who is it designed for?
faqs.answer: Sahayak AI is an enterprise-grade AI FAQ chatbot SaaS built for businesses, educational institutions, healthcare providers, and e-commerce stores looking to automate repetitive customer support queries with zero hallucinations using deterministic NLP matching.

faqs.question: How does Sahayak AI guarantee zero hallucinations in its responses?
faqs.answer: Unlike generative LLMs that may extrapolate or invent facts, Sahayak AI employs a deterministic vector space model combining TF-IDF term weighting and cosine similarity. It only returns verified answers explicitly present in your approved business knowledge base.

faqs.question: What languages does Sahayak AI support for customer queries?
faqs.answer: Sahayak AI natively supports English, Hindi, and Marathi, with a built-in multilingual translator, localized UI text, and speech recognition locales for all three languages.

faqs.question: Can Sahayak AI be deployed for internal company knowledge bases?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sahayak AI supports both public visitor-facing widgets and internal team knowledge bases, with role-based access control and separate audit logs for administrative sessions.

faqs.question: What industries benefit most from using Sahayak AI?
faqs.answer: Sahayak AI is widely adopted across e-commerce retail, SaaS software companies, educational universities, healthcare clinics, financial services, and customer care centers.

faqs.question: What is the uptime guarantee for the Sahayak AI platform?
faqs.answer: We guarantee a 99.9% uptime Service Level Agreement (SLA) for all Starter and Business tier workspaces, backed by redundant cloud infrastructure and automatic failover.

faqs.question: Do I need coding or AI engineering experience to use Sahayak AI?
faqs.answer: No coding skills are required. You can manage FAQs through our visual dashboard, import existing FAQs via CSV, customize brand colors, and copy a single script tag to embed the bot on your website.

faqs.question: Where is the Sahayak AI company headquarters located?
faqs.answer: Sahayak AI is headquartered in Bengaluru, India, with distributed engineering and customer support centers operating across the United States, Europe, and the Asia-Pacific region.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Sahayak AI and standard generative chatbots?
faqs.answer: Standard chatbots use generative models that can produce plausible-sounding but incorrect information. Sahayak AI uses mathematical vector similarity grounded strictly in approved corporate documentation, ensuring legally compliant, accurate customer guidance.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI support dark mode or custom theme styles?
faqs.answer: Yes. The chatbot widget features a responsive theme engine that automatically inherits your brand color palette and adapts cleanly to both light and dark website layouts.

faqs.question: How long has Sahayak AI been in active production?
faqs.answer: Sahayak AI was architected in 2026 as an enterprise NLP platform and has processed over 5 million customer inquiries across global SaaS deployments.

faqs.question: Can I try Sahayak AI before committing to a paid contract?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every newly registered workspace automatically receives our Free Tier plan with up to 500 free customer conversations per month and full access to the interactive demo sandbox.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI offer an on-premise or self-hosted deployment?
faqs.answer: Business and Enterprise tier customers can deploy Sahayak AI on private VPC clouds (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) or dedicated on-premise Docker Kubernetes clusters.

faqs.question: How frequently is the Sahayak AI platform updated?
faqs.answer: We deploy weekly zero-downtime platform updates, including NLP algorithmic enhancements, performance optimizations, and security patches.

faqs.question: Where can I read the latest product roadmap and feature announcements?
faqs.answer: You can view upcoming features, release notes, and community feature requests directly in the Dashboard under Settings or by visiting our public developer blog.

faqs.question: How do I create a new business workspace account?
faqs.answer: Visit the Sign Up page at /register, enter your name, corporate email address, password, and desired workspace name. Your workspace is provisioned immediately with full dashboard access.

faqs.question: Can I log in using my Google or GitHub account?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sahayak AI supports Single Sign-On (SSO) via Google and GitHub OAuth providers in addition to standard email and password authentication.

faqs.question: What password requirements are enforced during account registration?
faqs.answer: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long, include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one numeric digit, and one special character.

faqs.question: How do I invite team members to collaborate on my workspace?
faqs.answer: Go to Dashboard > Settings > Team Members, click 'Invite Member', and enter their email address along with their assigned role (Admin, Editor, or Viewer).

faqs.question: What are the different user roles available within a workspace?
faqs.answer: We provide four distinct roles: Owner (full administrative and billing ownership), Admin (manages FAQs, categories, and settings), Editor (can create and update FAQs), and Viewer (read-only access to analytics and chat logs).

faqs.question: How can I update my account email address or profile name?
faqs.answer: Navigate to Dashboard > Settings > Profile, update your full name or email address, and click 'Save Changes'. An email verification link will be sent to confirm any email changes.

faqs.question: What should I do if my account gets locked due to failed login attempts?
faqs.answer: If 5 consecutive failed login attempts occur, accounts are temporarily locked for 15 minutes to prevent brute-force attacks. You can wait 15 minutes or click 'Forgot Password' to unlock immediately.

faqs.question: Can I manage multiple business workspaces under a single user login?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can create or join multiple workspaces with one login and switch between them seamlessly using the workspace dropdown in the dashboard sidebar.

faqs.question: How do I permanently delete my account and associated data?
faqs.answer: Account deletion can be requested under Dashboard > Settings > Danger Zone. Clicking 'Delete Account' initiates a 7-day grace period, after which all personal data and workspace FAQs are permanently purged.

faqs.question: How do I configure email notifications for support handoff tickets?
faqs.answer: In Dashboard > Settings > Notifications, enable 'Email Alerts for New Tickets' and specify the destination email addresses for urgent visitor escalations.

faqs.question: Can I transfer ownership of my workspace to another team member?
faqs.answer: Yes. Workspace Owners can transfer primary ownership to any existing Admin member under Dashboard > Settings > Transfer Ownership.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI support SAML 2.0 or Okta enterprise SSO?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enterprise tier workspaces support SAML 2.0, Okta, Microsoft Azure Active Directory, and Google Workspace identity providers.

faqs.question: How do I view my current active login sessions across devices?
faqs.answer: Under Dashboard > Settings > Active Sessions, you can view all active browser sessions, IP locations, and device types, with a 1-click option to 'Log Out All Other Devices'.

faqs.question: Why am I not receiving password reset emails?
faqs.answer: Check your spam or junk folder for messages from no-reply@sahayak.ai. Ensure your corporate firewall permits transactional emails, or contact support to verify your account status.

faqs.question: Can I restrict dashboard access to specific IP addresses?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business and Enterprise tier workspaces can enable IP Whitelisting under Dashboard > Settings > Security to restrict dashboard access to authorized office or VPN subnets.

faqs.question: What core features are included in the Sahayak AI chatbot widget?
faqs.answer: The chatbot widget includes deterministic NLP cosine matching, browser Voice-to-Text, 3-language multilingual switching (English, Hindi, Marathi), Human Support handoff forms, smart suggested questions, and answer feedback ratings.

faqs.question: How does the Voice-to-Text speech recognition feature operate?
faqs.answer: The widget uses the browser's native Web Speech API. When the user taps the microphone button and grants permission, their speech is converted to text in real-time and placed into the chat input field without storing any raw audio recordings.

faqs.question: How does Human Support Handoff work when a user needs a live representative?
faqs.answer: If the chatbot cannot find an answer or if the user requests human assistance, a 'Contact Human Support' prompt appears. The user submits their query and contact details, creating a tracked support ticket in the business dashboard.

faqs.question: Can I bulk import existing FAQs from CSV or Excel files?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to Dashboard > FAQs, click 'Import CSV', and upload your file. Our system validates questions, answers, and category tags, displaying a preview before completing the import.

faqs.question: Can I export my workspace FAQs and conversation history?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can export all FAQs and sanitized conversation transcripts at any time as JSON or CSV files from the FAQs and Conversations dashboard pages.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI provide real-time chat analytics and usage reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Dashboard Analytics tab displays total conversation volume, query resolution rate, top matched FAQs, fallback query trends, and user satisfaction ratings.

faqs.question: How does the smart suggested questions system decide which prompts to show?
faqs.answer: Suggested questions are generated either automatically by sampling representative FAQs from each active category, or manually curated by the business owner in the Chatbot Customizer.

faqs.question: Can I customize the greeting and welcome message of the chatbot?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under Dashboard > Chatbot & Embed, you can customize the chatbot display name, greeting message, placeholder text, and brand accent colors with live preview.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI support conversation rating and visitor feedback?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every chatbot response includes Thumbs Up and Thumbs Down feedback buttons, allowing business owners to monitor answer quality and refine poorly rated responses.

faqs.question: Can I integrate Sahayak AI with Zendesk or Freshdesk?
faqs.answer: Yes. Business tier plans support outbound webhooks that automatically forward escalated human support tickets directly to Zendesk, Freshdesk, or Jira Service Management.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI offer Slack or Microsoft Teams alert integrations?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can connect a Slack or MS Teams webhook in Dashboard > Settings > Webhooks to receive instant channel notifications whenever an urgent support ticket is submitted.

faqs.question: How does the chatbot handle questions containing sensitive PII data?
faqs.answer: Before queries are stored in conversation history, our built-in privacy sanitizer detects and masks credit card numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, and Social Security IDs.

faqs.question: Can I embed the chatbot widget in mobile applications?
faqs.answer: Yes. The widget can be embedded in iOS and Android applications via WebView or connected directly using our RESTful JSON Chat API.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI provide a standalone full-screen chat interface?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each widget comes with a dedicated standalone URL (/widget/[publicId]) that can be shared via email, QR code, or SMS for full-screen mobile interactions.

faqs.question: How can I test chatbot responses before deploying the widget live?
faqs.answer: The Dashboard features a real-time Interactive Preview sandbox on the Chatbot page, allowing you to test questions, language switching, and voice input safely before publishing.

faqs.question: What is included in the Sahayak AI Free Tier plan?
faqs.answer: The Free Tier includes up to 500 monthly conversation turns, 50 FAQs, 4 categories, website embed script, Web Speech voice input, and 3-language translation at $0 per month.

faqs.question: How much does the Starter subscription plan cost and what does it include?
faqs.answer: The Starter plan is $29 per month (or $24/month billed annually) and includes up to 5,000 monthly conversations, unlimited FAQs, custom branding, and CSV import/export.

faqs.question: What features are exclusive to the Business subscription tier?
faqs.answer: The Business plan ($99/month) includes 25,000 conversations, priority email and phone support, multi-member team roles, custom webhooks, Supabase database sync, and SLA guarantees.

faqs.question: Do you offer discounts for annual billing or upfront payment?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer a 20% discount on all annual billing plans, equivalent to receiving more than 2 months of service free each year.

faqs.question: Do you provide special pricing for non-profit organizations or universities?
faqs.answer: Yes. Verified educational institutions, universities, and registered 501(c)(3) non-profit organizations receive a 35% lifetime discount across all subscription tiers.

faqs.question: Are there any hidden setup fees or implementation charges?
faqs.answer: No. There are zero setup fees, activation charges, or hidden transaction fees on any Sahayak AI subscription plan.

faqs.question: What happens if my workspace exceeds the monthly conversation quota?
faqs.answer: When usage reaches 80% and 100% of your plan limit, we send email alerts. If exceeded, you can upgrade your plan or enable overage conversations at $0.005 per additional conversation.

faqs.question: Can I upgrade or downgrade my subscription plan at any time?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can switch plans anytime in Dashboard > Settings > Billing. Upgrades take effect immediately with prorated billing, and downgrades apply at the end of the current billing cycle.

faqs.question: How do I download tax invoices and payment receipts?
faqs.answer: All past invoices and downloadable PDF receipts with GST/VAT tax breakdown are available under Dashboard > Settings > Billing & Invoices.

faqs.question: Can I enter my corporate GSTIN or VAT tax registration number?
faqs.answer: Yes. In Dashboard > Settings > Billing, enter your company legal name and GSTIN/VAT number so it appears on all generated tax invoices.

faqs.question: Do you accept international currencies other than USD?
faqs.answer: Yes. Through our Stripe payment gateway, we accept payments in USD ($), INR (₹), EUR (€), GBP (£), CAD, and AUD with automatic local conversion.

faqs.question: What happens to my data if my subscription payment fails?
faqs.answer: If a renewal payment fails, we provide a 7-day grace period with automatic retry reminders. Your chatbot remains active during the grace period before reverting to Free Tier mode.

faqs.question: Can I pay using bank wire transfer or ACH direct debit?
faqs.answer: Annual Business and custom Enterprise tier contracts can be paid via ACH direct debit, SEPA transfer, or international wire transfer.

faqs.question: How can I pause my subscription temporarily without deleting data?
faqs.answer: You can downgrade to the Free Tier to pause paid billing while keeping all your knowledge base FAQs, widget designs, and history intact.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI charge per user seat or per workspace?
faqs.answer: Our pricing is workspace-based with conversation volume quotas, allowing you to invite unlimited team collaborators without paying per-seat license fees.

faqs.question: What browsers are supported by the Sahayak AI chatbot widget?
faqs.answer: The chatbot widget supports all modern evergreen browsers including Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari, Microsoft Edge, and Opera on desktop and mobile platforms.

faqs.question: How do I embed the chatbot script tag on WordPress or Shopify?
faqs.answer: Copy the script tag from Dashboard > Chatbot & Embed and paste it into your WordPress theme header.php file or Shopify theme.liquid file immediately before the closing </body> tag.

faqs.question: Does the embedded chatbot script affect my website load speed?
faqs.answer: No. The embed script is under 15 KB, loads asynchronously with the defer attribute, and executes from a global edge CDN without blocking your core page rendering.

faqs.question: How can I restrict which domain names can load my embed widget?
faqs.answer: In Dashboard > Chatbot & Embed > Allowed Domains, enter your authorized website domains (e.g., example.com). Requests from unauthorized origins are rejected automatically.

faqs.question: What is the average response latency of the NLP matching engine?
faqs.answer: Average NLP retrieval latency is between 2ms and 8ms for in-domain queries, ensuring instantaneous answers even during high-traffic spikes.

faqs.question: How can I query the chatbot using our custom backend REST API?
faqs.answer: Send a POST request to /api/chat with a JSON body containing workspaceId, query, and language. The API returns the matched answer, confidence score, and suggested follow-ups.

faqs.question: What should I do if the chatbot widget does not appear on my site?
faqs.answer: Verify that the data-public-id attribute matches your widget ID, ensure your domain is listed in Allowed Domains, check your browser console for Content Security Policy errors, and disable aggressive ad-blockers.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI support Content Security Policy (CSP) headers?
faqs.answer: Yes. To allow the widget under strict CSP, add our CDN domain to your script-src, connect-src, and frame-src directives.

faqs.question: Can I trigger the chatbot to open automatically using JavaScript?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can trigger the widget programmatically by calling window.SahayakAI.open() or window.SahayakAI.sendQuery('What are your hours?') from any custom button or script.

faqs.question: How does the TF-IDF and Cosine Similarity vector model calculate relevance?
faqs.answer: The preprocessor converts text into normalized n-gram token vectors with inverse document frequency weighting. Cosine similarity computes the cosine of the angle between query and FAQ vectors on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0.

faqs.question: What threshold is used to distinguish between valid answers and fallbacks?
faqs.answer: Our calibrated confidence threshold is 0.25 composite similarity. Scores above 0.25 trigger approved answers, while scores below 0.25 safely trigger graceful fallback navigation.

faqs.question: How do I configure incoming Webhooks to receive support requests?
faqs.answer: In Dashboard > Settings > Webhooks, enter your server endpoint URL and secret key. We dispatch a JSON payload with ticket details whenever a human support request is submitted.

faqs.question: Can I connect Sahayak AI directly to an external Supabase PostgreSQL database?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can provide your NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variables to synchronize all FAQs, sessions, and tickets directly to your PostgreSQL database.

faqs.question: How does the speech recognition handle background noise?
faqs.answer: The Web Speech API integrates your operating system's built-in noise suppression and acoustic beamforming to isolate the speaker's voice from ambient office and cafe noise.

faqs.question: What is the technical support team's response time SLA?
faqs.answer: Standard support tickets are answered within 12 business hours. Business tier customers receive 24/7 priority response within 2 hours.

faqs.question: Is Sahayak AI compliant with GDPR and CCPA data privacy laws?
faqs.answer: Yes. Sahayak AI is fully compliant with GDPR and CCPA. We provide complete data export, configurable retention windows, PII masking, and right-to-be-forgotten deletion workflows.

faqs.question: How is multi-tenant workspace data segregated in the database?
faqs.answer: Every workspace is assigned an isolated UUID. All database repositories enforce strict workspaceId filters on every query, preventing cross-tenant data leakage.

faqs.question: What encryption standards protect data in transit and at rest?
faqs.answer: All data in transit is encrypted using TLS 1.3 with forward secrecy. Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 standard encryption across all storage tiers.

faqs.question: How does the PII sanitizer identify and redact personal information?
faqs.answer: The privacy sanitizer utilizes regular expression tokenizers to detect 16-digit credit card numbers, email addresses, phone numbers, and government identification strings, replacing them with [REDACTED] tokens before persistence.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI train public AI models on our proprietary business data?
faqs.answer: No. Your knowledge base FAQs, customer questions, and audit logs are strictly private to your workspace and are never used to train public models or shared with third parties.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI undergo regular third-party penetration testing?
faqs.answer: Yes. We undergo bi-annual third-party penetration testing and automated daily vulnerability scans adhering to OWASP Top 10 security standards.

faqs.question: How are administrative session tokens secured against tampering?
faqs.answer: Authentication session cookies use HMAC-SHA256 signatures with HttpOnly, Secure, and SameSite=Lax flags, preventing cross-site scripting (XSS) and CSRF attacks.

faqs.question: Can I configure automatic chat history retention and deletion policies?
faqs.answer: Yes. In Dashboard > Settings > Data Retention, you can configure conversations to automatically purge after 30, 60, 90, or 365 days, or retain indefinitely.

faqs.question: How does Sahayak AI protect against Denial of Service (DoS) attacks?
faqs.answer: Our edge infrastructure enforces Cloudflare DDoS mitigation alongside per-IP and per-workspace rate limiting to prevent abuse and malicious automated traffic.

faqs.question: Are employee access permissions governed by the Principle of Least Privilege?
faqs.answer: Yes. Internal access to production customer environments requires multi-factor authentication, cryptographic key pairing, and justified approval logs with automatic expiration.

faqs.question: Does Sahayak AI provide SOC 2 Type II compliance reports?
faqs.answer: Yes. SOC 2 Type II compliance attestation reports are available to Enterprise customers under standard non-disclosure agreement (NDA).

faqs.question: How are administrator passwords stored in the database?
faqs.answer: Passwords are never stored in plaintext. They are cryptographically hashed using bcrypt with an adaptive work factor (salt rounds: 10).

faqs.question: Where can security researchers report potential vulnerabilities?
faqs.answer: Security researchers can report findings to security@sahayak.ai. We operate an active responsible disclosure and bug bounty program.

faqs.question: What is your money-back guarantee policy for new subscriptions?
faqs.answer: We offer a 100% money-back guarantee within the first 14 days of subscribing to any paid plan if you are not completely satisfied with Sahayak AI.

faqs.question: How long does it take for an approved refund to reflect in my bank account?
faqs.answer: Approved refunds are processed through our payment gateway within 24 hours and typically appear on your credit card or bank statement within 5 to 7 business days.

faqs.question: How do I cancel my subscription before the next renewal date?
faqs.answer: To cancel, navigate to Dashboard > Settings > Billing and click 'Cancel Subscription'. Your access remains active until the end of the paid billing period with no further charges.

faqs.question: Can I receive a prorated refund if I cancel midway through an annual plan?
faqs.answer: Annual plan cancellations requested after the initial 14-day guarantee period receive prorated service credit or partial refunds upon review by our customer success team.

faqs.question: Where can I read the full Terms of Service agreement?
faqs.answer: Our complete Terms of Service agreement is accessible at /terms and outlines acceptable use, service availability, user responsibilities, and intellectual property terms.

faqs.question: Where can I review your Privacy Policy document?
faqs.answer: Our Privacy Policy is available at /privacy and details our strict data collection limits, processing safeguards, cookie policy, and third-party disclosure protections.

faqs.question: What is the policy regarding automated abuse and web scraping?
faqs.answer: Automated scraping, reverse engineering, or intentional flooding of chat endpoints is strictly prohibited and results in immediate account suspension under our Acceptable Use Policy.

faqs.question: Do you offer a formal Service Level Agreement (SLA) credit for outages?
faqs.answer: Yes. If system availability falls below our 99.9% monthly SLA commitment, affected Business tier customers are eligible for billing credits up to 30% of their monthly invoice.

faqs.question: Who retains intellectual property ownership of the FAQs I upload?
faqs.answer: You retain 100% intellectual property ownership of all FAQs, customer questions, brand logos, and content created or imported into your workspace.

faqs.question: What happens to our knowledge base if Sahayak AI deprecates a feature?
faqs.answer: We guarantee a minimum 6-month advance notice prior to modifying or deprecating any core API or service feature, along with automated data migration tools.

faqs.question: How can I request a customized Data Processing Addendum (DPA)?
faqs.answer: Customers operating under GDPR requirements can download our standard DPA or request an executed addendum by emailing legal@sahayak.ai.

faqs.question: Can I change my billing country or tax residency after signing up?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can update your billing address and tax jurisdiction under Dashboard > Settings > Billing. Changes take effect on the following billing cycle.
